why_it_matters: Charter changes, including how the Town Manager is appointed and replaced, would reach voters at a fall special Town Meeting rather than the spring one, so any vote residents are asked to take comes later.
No votes were taken, so the proposals remain drafts and the public hearing in the proposed schedule is the first planned point for residents to comment.
